{"parentUuid":"d9c62934-fa02-43d8-b426-e4d5843bda8c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"492d1493-7de3-495d-96fe-99327141ed43","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UVkxGSymWHYd32SMt4Ah1R","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/notes/client-brief.md has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"65d09ef1-af05-4b5c-b966-076aadda8efe","timestamp":"2026-09-29T03:46:54.106Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/notes/client-brief.md","oldString":"- **Permanent pages are Home, Menu, and Our Story.** Only the admin can edit them.\n  **News** is the list of published posts (the \"Posts\" capability), which the editor\n  can draft and the admin can publish.","newString":"- **Pages start as Home, Menu, and Our Story**, seeded by `scripts/seed_demo.py`.\n  Only the admin can create, edit, or delete a Page — matching the MP2 rubric's\n  \"Pages: same fields and operations as posts,\" so this is initial content, not a\n  fixed ceiling (corrected 2026-09-29; an earlier version of this brief called the\n  three \"permanent\" in a way that implied no others could ever be added — see the\n  comment on spec issue #1). **News** is the list of published posts (the \"Posts\"\n  capability), which the editor can draft and the admin can publish.","originalFile":"# Client brief: La Once Mil, Lomas de Chapultepec, Mexico City\n\n## Why this client\n\nI picked this restaurant because the Michelin-star story is compelling: a taqueria — a\ncategory of restaurant normally associated with cheap, fast street food — won a Michelin\nstar in 2026, the only taquería to hold that distinction. That tension (a $20 wagyu taco next\nto a genre built on $1 street tacos) is a strong hook for a \"what can I eat here, where is it,\nwhen is it open\" public site, and the restaurant's real story (chef César de la Parra\ndeliberately elevating a street-food format he grew up on) gives the \"Our Story\" page\nsomething specific to say instead of generic restaurant copy.\n\n**Scope note:** this project models only the flagship location — Monte Everest 780, Lomas\nde Chapultepec — the Michelin-starred address. The restaurant also operates a second Mexico\nCity branch (Roma Norte) and, as of very recently (Sept 2026), a Madrid location; both are\nexplicitly out of scope. See `notes/restaurant-research.md` for full sourcing and the\nnaming decision (site uses \"La Once Mil,\" the restaurant's own verified branding; an\nearlier draft of this brief used \"Tacos La Oncemil,\" which was corrected on 2026-09-28).\n\n## Who runs the site, and how comfortable are they with computers?\n\n**Proposed assumption, not a verified fact** (I have not contacted the restaurant): the site\nis modeled as run by the owner, César de la Parra, posting everything himself. He's a working\nchef running a 55-seat, ~80-staff restaurant — comfortable enough to run Instagram and\nTikTok accounts personally, but with no patience for a complicated publishing workflow. He\nneeds to post fast between service, not fight with a CMS. This means the editor UI has to be\nsimple even though, today, there's only one real user.\n\nThe CMS still needs two enforced roles (admin/editor) per the assignment's fixed\nrequirements — the brief models a plausible future where a manager or social-media hire gets\nan editor account without touching user management, permanent-page content (Home, Menu, Our\nStory — which includes the address/hours/directions on Home), or publishing.\n\n## Who reads it, and what are they usually trying to find?\n\nTwo kinds of visitors, inferred from the restaurant's real profile (no reservations, walk-in\nonly, high foot traffic from the Michelin attention, no functioning official website today):\n\n- **First-time visitors drawn by the Michelin coverage**, wanting to know: what's the\n  signature dish, what does it cost, where exactly is it, when is it open, is a reservation\n  needed (no).\n- **Repeat/local visitors** wanting quick answers: today's hours, any seasonal menu news,\n  confirmation the place hasn't moved.\n\n## What's broken about how they do it now?\n\nVerified from research: the restaurant has no functioning official website (`laoncemil.com`\nexists but shows only \"under construction\"). Its entire online presence is Instagram,\nTikTok, and a Linktree — none of which answer \"where and when\" quickly, and all of which bury\nthat information under a scrolling feed. Someone who doesn't already follow the account has\nno fast way to get the address and hours without digging through an Instagram bio.\n\n## What would make them say \"this is better\"?\n\nA page that says, in one glance: what the signature dishes are, that it's walk-in only\n(setting the right expectation before someone shows up expecting to book), the exact address\nand hours, and a way to see it's a real, currently-open, currently-relevant place (recent\nannouncements) without needing to already follow the Instagram.\n\n## What must not happen\n\n**This site must never imply that Tacos La Oncemil / La Once Mil commissioned, endorsed, or\nwas involved in building this project.** It is a student prototype built for a class\nassignment using publicly available, verified information. Any demonstration content (sample\nannouncements, seed data) must be clearly labeled as such, not presented as if the restaurant\nposted it.\n\n## Confirmed decisions (2026-09-28, in `/grill-with-docs`)\n\n- **Site display name is \"La Once Mil\"** — the restaurant's own verified branding.\n  (Corrects the earlier \"Tacos La Oncemil\" spelling used when this brief was started;\n  that was not an intentional name choice. See `notes/restaurant-research.md`.)\n- **Publishing is admin-only.** Only the manager/admin role can publish content live;\n  the demo editor can create and edit announcement drafts but cannot publish, cannot\n  reach Pages at all (create, edit, or delete), and cannot manage users. The\n  admin can do everything. This is a class prototype modeling a hypothetical future\n  hire, not real restaurant staff.\n- **Demo accounts are fictional, not the real owner.** Seed users are named\n  **\"Demo Manager\"** (admin) and **\"Demo Editor\"** (editor) — required to demonstrate\n  both roles for grading, but explicitly not claiming to be César de la Parra or any\n  real staff member.\n- **Homepage priority order: address, hours, directions first.** Of the \"what/where/when\"\n  facts a first-time visitor needs, address/hours/directions rank above signature-dish\n  or walk-in-only copy on the homepage specifically (those still belong on the page,\n  just not the top fold).\n- **Contact method is phone only.** No contact form, no email address surfaced to\n  customers — a phone number is the one channel offered for reaching the restaurant.\n- **Menu is one ordinary Markdown page** (dish names and descriptions), not a\n  structured menu/pricing database. No unverified peso prices are included, per\n  `notes/restaurant-research.md`'s pricing caveat.\n- **News/announcements may include one real, dated item** — the Michelin star\n  announcement, since the Michelin Guide page directly confirms the exact distinction\n  (\"One MICHELIN Star\") and attributes it to the Lomas de Chapultepec address\n  specifically (see `notes/restaurant-research.md`). Any other seed announcements are\n  invented sample content and must be clearly labeled as demo, not real restaurant\n  posts.\n- **Images: placeholders now, real photos intended for the final version.** Build\n  proceeds today with clearly labeled placeholders (e.g. `[PLACEHOLDER: storefront\n  photo]`) so nothing blocks on photo access. See \"Image tracker\" below for what's\n  still needed before final.\n\n## Image tracker (placeholders in use until these are supplied)\n\n| Needed for | Status | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| Homepage hero image | Placeholder | Storefront or signature dish shot, Lomas de Chapultepec location only |\n| Menu page image(s) | Placeholder | Food shots; no prices, per pricing caveat |\n| Our Story image | Placeholder | Chef/kitchen or storefront shot |\n| News/announcement images (optional, per post) | Placeholder | Only if a specific post needs one |\n\nPer `notes/restaurant-research.md`: the three photos found in the Michelin article are\ncredited \"© La Once Mil\" (editorial credit, not a republishing license) and are **not\ncleared for use**. Real photos must come from the user's own Instagram pulls (with\npost date/caption/credit noted) or the user's own photography — not these Michelin\narticle images, and not AI-generated or stock substitutes.\n\n## Page structure (2026-09-28, in `/grill-with-docs`)\n\n- **Home covers visiting information entirely** — verified address, hours, a\n  directions link, and a prominent Call button live on Home itself. There is **no\n  separate Visit Us page**; the earlier assumption elsewhere in this brief of a\n  standalone Visit Us/Hours page is superseded by this decision.\n- **Permanent pages are Home, Menu, and Our Story.** Only the admin can edit them.\n  **News** is the list of published posts (the \"Posts\" capability), which the editor\n  can draft and the admin can publish.\n- **Publishing marks content published in the local CMS only.** The public GitHub\n  Pages site does not update automatically — it reflects the new state only after\n  `cms publish` exports to `site/` and that export is deployed to Pages. \"Published\"\n  and \"live on the public site\" are two different moments.\n- **Every published page, including Home, must be reachable through navigation.**\n  Home is the entry point rather than a separate nav link, but Menu, Our Story, and\n  News must all be linked from it (and from each other) so no published content is\n  an orphan page.\n\n## Still open\n\nNone — `/grill-with-docs` frontier is closed as of 2026-09-28. Proceed to `/to-spec`.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":120,"oldLines":9,"newStart":120,"newLines":13,"lines":["   directions link, and a prominent Call button live on Home itself. See ADR-002 for why\nthere is no ORM here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\n\n# La Once Mil's initial Pages (see notes/restaurant-research.md); this is\n# seed content, not a limit. Per the MP2 rubric/manual (\"Pages: same fields\n# and operations as posts, plus public navigation\"), Pages support full\n# create/read/update/delete like Posts — the Manager can add or remove pages\n# beyond this starting set.\nPAGE_SLUGS = (\"home\", \"menu\", \"our-story\")\nPAGE_TITLES = {\"home\": \"Home\", \"menu\": \"Menu\", \"our-story\": \"Our Story\"}\n\nUSERS_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1\n);\n\"\"\"\n\nPAGES_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    author_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"\n\nSCHEMA = USERS_SCHEMA + PAGES_SCHEMA\n\nSLUG_PATTERN = \"^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$\"\n\n_PAGE_COLUMNS = \"id, slug, title, body_md, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at\"\n\n\ndef _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A database created before Pages supported full CRUD has\n    `CHECK (slug IN ('home', 'menu', 'our-story'))` baked into the `pages`\n    table — `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` never touches an existing table, so\n    that CHECK would otherwise survive forever and silently block creating\n    any other page. Rebuild the table from PAGES_SCHEMA, keeping every row.\n    \"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n    ).fetchone()\n    if row is None or row[0] is None or \"CHECK (slug IN\" not in row[0]:\n        return\n    conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE pages RENAME TO pages_legacy\")\n    conn.executescript(PAGES_SCHEMA)\n    conn.execute(\n        f\"INSERT INTO pages ({_PAGE_COLUMNS}) \"\n        f\"SELECT {_PAGE_COLUMNS} FROM pages_legacy\"\n    )\n    conn.execute(\"DROP TABLE pages_legacy\")","numLines":70,"startLine":1,"totalLines":208}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d90ac5f6-8da9-411a-a4ad-1dfdceab72d0","session_id":"a2316d11-3941-4d87-98fe-7d21dea1d9fa","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"2fa5b7df-506f-4d8e-a53d-7174fd72d15b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"main"}

See ADR-002 for why\nthere is no ORM here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\n\n# La Once Mil's initial Pages (see notes/restaurant-research.md); this is\n# seed content, not a limit. Per the MP2 rubric/manual (\"Pages: same fields\n# and operations as posts, plus public navigation\"), Pages support full\n# create/read/update/delete like Posts — the Manager can add or remove pages\n# beyond this starting set.\nPAGE_SLUGS = (\"home\", \"menu\", \"our-story\")\nPAGE_TITLES = {\"home\": \"Home\", \"menu\": \"Menu\", \"our-story\": \"Our Story\"}\n\nUSERS_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1\n);\n\"\"\"\n\nPAGES_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    author_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"\n\nSCHEMA = USERS_SCHEMA + PAGES_SCHEMA\n\nSLUG_PATTERN = \"^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$\"\n\n_PAGE_COLUMNS = \"id, slug, title, body_md, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at\"\n\n\ndef _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A database created before Pages supported full CRUD has\n    `CHECK (slug IN ('home', 'menu', 'our-story'))` baked into the `pages`\n    table — `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` never touches an existing table, so\n    that CHECK would otherwise survive forever and silently block creating\n    any other page. Rebuild the table from PAGES_SCHEMA, keeping every row.\n    \"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n    ).fetchone()\n    if row is None or row[0] is None or \"CHECK (slug IN\" not in row[0]:\n        return\n    conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE pages RENAME TO pages_legacy\")\n    conn.executescript(PAGES_SCHEMA)\n    conn.execute(\n        f\"INSERT INTO pages ({_PAGE_COLUMNS}) \"\n        f\"SELECT {_PAGE_COLUMNS} FROM pages_legacy\"\n    )\n    conn.execute(\"DROP TABLE pages_legacy\")\n\n\ndef get_connection(path: Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path or settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef init_db(path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the schema and, only the first time the `pages` table is\n    created, seed the starting Pages. Pages are freely creatable/deletable\n    (see PAGE_SLUGS' docstring) and `init_db` runs again on every `cms serve`\n    restart, so this keys off whether the table already existed — not\n    whether it's currently empty — or deleting every page would make the\n    next restart look identical to a brand-new database and recreate them.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = get_connection(path)\n    try:\n        table_already_existed = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n        ).fetchone() is not None\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn)\n        if not table_already_existed:\n            for slug in PAGE_SLUGS:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                    (slug, PAGE_TITLES[slug]),\n                )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef create_user(email: str, password: str, role: str, *, active: bool = True) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, auth.hash_password(password), role, int(active)),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_id(user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_active(email: str, *, active: bool) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE email = ?\", (int(active), email)\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_page_by_slug(slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages ORDER BY slug\").fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(slug: str, *, title: str, body_md: str, status: str, author_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"\"\"UPDATE pages\n               SET title = ?, body_md = ?, status = ?, author_id = ?,\n                   updated_at = datetime('now')\n               WHERE slug = ?\"\"\",\n            (title, body_md, status, author_id, slug),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef slug_is_valid(slug: str) -> bool:\n    return re.fullmatch(SLUG_PATTERN, slug) is not None\n\n\ndef create_page(slug: str, *, title: str, body_md: str, status: str, author_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Insert a new page. Rebuild the table from PAGES_SCHEMA, keeping every row.\n\n    This runs as one explicit transaction (isolation_level=None plus our own\n    BEGIN/COMMIT) rather than relying on the connection's default autocommit\n    handling or `executescript()`: `executescript()` implicitly commits\n    pending work before it runs, and under the default isolation level a DDL\n    statement like ALTER/CREATE/DROP TABLE can commit independently of a\n    later `conn.commit()`. Either would let a crash between steps (process\n    killed, power loss) orphan the renamed table with real content in it\n    while the app reads a freshly emptied `pages` table — confirmed with a\n    crash simulation (kill before the final commit, reopen, check for data\n    loss) before writing it this way.\n    \"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n    ).fetchone()\n    if row is None or row[0] is None or \"CHECK (slug IN\" not in row[0]:\n        return\n\n    previous_isolation_level = conn.isolation_level\n    conn.isolation_level = None\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n        conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE pages RENAME TO pages_legacy\")\n        conn.execute(PAGES_SCHEMA)\n        conn.execute(\n            f\"INSERT INTO pages ({_PAGE_COLUMNS}) \"\n            f\"SELECT {_PAGE_COLUMNS} FROM pages_legacy\"\n        )\n        conn.execute(\"DROP TABLE pages_legacy\")\n        conn.execute(\"COMMIT\")\n    except Exception:\n        conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK\")\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.isolation_level = previous_isolation_level\n\n\ndef get_connection(path: Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path or settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef init_db(path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the schema and, only the first time the `pages` table is\n    created, seed the starting Pages. Pages are freely creatable/deletable\n    (see PAGE_SLUGS' docstring) and `init_db` runs again on every `cms serve`\n    restart, so this keys off whether the table already existed — not\n    whether it's currently empty — or deleting every page would make the\n    next restart look identical to a brand-new database and recreate them.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = get_connection(path)\n    try:\n        table_already_existed = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n        ).fetchone() is not None\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn)\n        if not table_already_existed:\n            for slug in PAGE_SLUGS:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                    (slug, PAGE_TITLES[slug]),\n                )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef create_user(email: str, password: str, role: str, *, active: bool = True) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, auth.hash_password(password), role, int(active)),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_id(user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_active(email: str, *, active: bool) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE email = ?\", (int(active), email)\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_page_by_slug(slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages ORDER BY slug\").fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(slug: str, *, title: str, body_md: str, status: str, author_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"\"\"UPDATE pages\n               SET title = ?, body_md = ?, status = ?, author_id = ?,\n                   updated_at = datetime('now')\n               WHERE slug = ?\"\"\",\n            (title, body_md, status, author_id, slug),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef slug_is_valid(slug: str) -> bool:\n    return re.fullmatch(SLUG_PATTERN, slug) is not None\n\n\ndef create_page(slug: str, *, title: str, body_md: str, status: str, author_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Insert a new page. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"5a67e3e0-8c1c-4292-925c-fa5fe1cd8470","timestamp":"2026-09-29T03:51:11.373Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/db.py","oldString":"    conn = get_connection(path)\n    try:\n        table_already_existed = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n        ).fetchone() is not None\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn)\n        if not table_already_existed:","newString":"    conn = get_connection(path)\n    try:\n        existing_pages_row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n        ).fetchone()\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn, existing_pages_row[0] if existing_pages_row else None)\n        if existing_pages_row is None:","originalFile":"\"\"\"SQLite connection and the users table.\n\nOne file, gitignored, rebuilt by `scripts/seed_demo.py`. See ADR-002 for why\nthere is no ORM here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\n\n# La Once Mil's initial Pages (see notes/restaurant-research.md); this is\n# seed content, not a limit. Per the MP2 rubric/manual (\"Pages: same fields\n# and operations as posts, plus public navigation\"), Pages support full\n# create/read/update/delete like Posts — the Manager can add or remove pages\n# beyond this starting set.\nPAGE_SLUGS = (\"home\", \"menu\", \"our-story\")\nPAGE_TITLES = {\"home\": \"Home\", \"menu\": \"Menu\", \"our-story\": \"Our Story\"}\n\nUSERS_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1\n);\n\"\"\"\n\nPAGES_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    author_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"\n\nSCHEMA = USERS_SCHEMA + PAGES_SCHEMA\n\nSLUG_PATTERN = \"^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$\"\n\n_PAGE_COLUMNS = \"id, slug, title, body_md, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at\"\n\n\ndef _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn: sqlite3.Connection, existing_pages_sql: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A database created before Pages supported full CRUD has\n    `CHECK (slug IN ('home', 'menu', 'our-story'))` baked into the `pages`\n    table — `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` never touches an existing table, so\n    that CHECK would otherwise survive forever and silently block creating\n    any other page. Rebuild the table from PAGES_SCHEMA, keeping every row.\n\n    This runs as one explicit transaction (isolation_level=None plus our own\n    BEGIN/COMMIT) rather than relying on the connection's default autocommit\n    handling or `executescript()`: `executescript()` implicitly commits\n    pending work before it runs, and under the default isolation level a DDL\n    statement like ALTER/CREATE/DROP TABLE can commit independently of a\n    later `conn.commit()`. Either would let a crash between steps (process\n    killed, power loss) orphan the renamed table with real content in it\n    while the app reads a freshly emptied `pages` table — confirmed with a\n    crash simulation (kill before the final commit, reopen, check for data\n    loss) before writing it this way.\n    \"\"\"\n    if existing_pages_sql is None or \"CHECK (slug IN\" not in existing_pages_sql:\n        return\n\n    previous_isolation_level = conn.isolation_level\n    conn.isolation_level = None\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n        conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE pages RENAME TO pages_legacy\")\n        conn.execute(PAGES_SCHEMA)\n        conn.execute(\n            f\"INSERT INTO pages ({_PAGE_COLUMNS}) \"\n            f\"SELECT {_PAGE_COLUMNS} FROM pages_legacy\"\n        )\n        conn.execute(\"DROP TABLE pages_legacy\")\n        conn.execute(\"COMMIT\")\n    except Exception:\n        conn.execute(\"ROLLBACK\")\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.isolation_level = previous_isolation_level\n\n\ndef get_connection(path: Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path or settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef init_db(path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the schema and, only the first time the `pages` table is\n    created, seed the starting Pages. Pages are freely creatable/deletable\n    (see PAGE_SLUGS' docstring) and `init_db` runs again on every `cms serve`\n    restart, so this keys off whether the table already existed — not\n    whether it's currently empty — or deleting every page would make the\n    next restart look identical to a brand-new database and recreate them.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = get_connection(path)\n    try:\n        table_already_existed = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"\n        ).fetchone() is not None\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn)\n        if not table_already_existed:\n            for slug in PAGE_SLUGS:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                    (slug, PAGE_TITLES[slug]),\n                )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef create_user(email: str, password: str, role: str, *, active: bool = True) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, auth.hash_password(password), role, int(active)),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user_by_id(user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_active(email: str, *, active: bool) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE email = ?\", (int(active), email)\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_page_by_slug(slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages ORDER BY slug\").fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(slug: str, *, title: str, body_md: str, status: str, author_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"\"\"UPDATE pages\n               SET title = ?, body_md = ?, status = ?, author_id = ?,\n                   updated_at = datetime('now')\n               WHERE slug = ?\"\"\",\n            (title, body_md, status, author_id, slug),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef slug_is_valid(slug: str) -> bool:\n    return re.fullmatch(SLUG_PATTERN, slug) is not None\n\n\ndef create_page(slug: str, *, title: str, body_md: str, status: str, author_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Insert a new page. Returns False if the slug is already taken.\"\"\"\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title, body_md, status, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (slug, title, body_md, status, author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return True\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return False\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_page(slug: str) -> None:\n    conn = get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":105,"oldLines":12,"newStart":105,"newLines":12,"lines":["     \"\"\"","     conn = get_connection(path)","     try:","-        table_already_existed = conn.execute(","-            \"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"","-        ).fetchone() is not None","+        existing_pages_row = conn.execute(","+            \"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'pages'\"","+        ).fetchone()","         conn.executescript(SCHEMA)","-        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn)","-        if not table_already_existed:","+        _migrate_legacy_page_slug_check(conn, existing_pages_row[0] if existing_pages_row else None)","+        if existing_pages_row is None:","             for slug in PAGE_SLUGS:","                 conn.execute(","                     \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title) VALUES (?, ?)\","]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f4e6b965-b9b7-4830-8cd3-16344126d0a1","session_id":"a2316d11-3941-4d87-98fe-7d21dea1d9fa","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"2fa5b7df-506f-4d8e-a53d-7174fd72d15b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"main"}

reopened.close()","originalFile":"\"\"\"T02: Pages (create/read/update/delete), seeded with Home, Menu, Our Story.\n\nPer the MP2 rubric/manual, Pages support the same CRUD operations as Posts;\nHome/Menu/Our Story are La Once Mil's starting content, not a hard limit.\nCovers a Manager creating, editing, and deleting a page, an Editor blocked on\nevery route (UI and a hand-crafted direct POST/DELETE), an anonymous visitor\nredirected to login, and Markdown sanitization of a script/onerror payload.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\ndef _csrf(client, path):\n    response = client.get(path)\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    return response.cookies[\"csrf_token\"]\n\n\ndef test_manager_can_edit_a_permanent_page(client_as):\n    manager = client_as(\"admin\")\n    csrf = _csrf(manager, \"/admin/pages/home\")\n    response = manager.post(\n        \"/admin/pages/home\",\n        data={\n            \"title\": \"Home\",\n            \"body_md\": \"Visit us at Monte Everest 780, Lomas de Chapultepec.\",\n            \"status\": \"published\",\n            \"csrf_token\": csrf,\n        },\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    page = db.get_page_by_slug(\"home\")\n    assert page[\"status\"] == \"published\"\n    assert \"Monte Everest 780\" in page[\"body_md\"]\n    assert page[\"author_id\"] is not None\n\n\ndef test_editor_is_blocked_from_edit_form(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.get(\"/admin/pages/home\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_editor_is_blocked_from_pages_list(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.get(\"/admin/pages\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_editor_is_blocked_from_a_direct_post(client_as):\n    \"\"\"A forged POST with no prior UI visit must still be rejected by role,\n    not merely by a missing CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\n        \"/admin/pages/home\",\n        data={\"title\": \"Hijacked\", \"body_md\": \"x\", \"status\": \"published\",\n              \"csrf_token\": \"not-even-a-real-token\"},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert db.get_page_by_slug(\"home\")[\"title\"] != \"Hijacked\"\n\n\ndef test_anonymous_is_redirected_to_login(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/pages/home\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"].endswith(\"/login\")\n\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/admin/pages/home\",\n        data={\"title\": \"x\", \"body_md\": \"x\", \"status\": \"draft\"},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"].endswith(\"/login\")\n\n\ndef test_saved_markdown_is_sanitized(client_as):\n    manager = client_as(\"admin\")\n    csrf = _csrf(manager, \"/admin/pages/menu\")\n    payload = '<script>alert(1)</script><img src=x onerror=\"alert(2)\">Tacos al pastor'\n    response = manager.post(\n        \"/admin/pages/menu\",\n        data={\"title\": \"Menu\", \"body_md\": payload, \"status\": \"draft\", \"csrf_token\": csrf},\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n    page = db.get_page_by_slug(\"menu\")\n    assert \"<script\" not in page[\"body_md\"]\n    assert \"onerror\" not in page[\"body_md\"]\n    assert \"Tacos al pastor\" in page[\"body_md\"]\n\n    assert \"<script\" not in response.text\n    assert \"onerror\" not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_saving_plain_text_does_not_corrupt_it(client_as):\n    \"\"\"Regression: sanitizing raw Markdown must not HTML-entity-encode\n    ordinary characters (e.g. \"&\" -> \"&amp;\"), which would corrupt the\n    stored text on every save/reload round trip.\"\"\"\n    manager = client_as(\"admin\")\n    csrf = _csrf(manager, \"/admin/pages/menu\")\n    manager.post(\n        \"/admin/pages/menu\",\n        data={\"title\": \"Menu\", \"body_md\": \"Tacos & salsa, \\\"al pastor\\\"\",\n              \"status\": \"draft\", \"csrf_token\": csrf},\n    )\n    page = db.get_page_by_slug(\"menu\")\n    assert page[\"body_md\"] == 'Tacos & salsa, \"al pastor\"'\n\n\ndef test_manager_can_create_a_page(client_as):\n    manager = client_as(\"admin\")\n    csrf = _csrf(manager, \"/admin/pages/new\")\n    response = manager.post(\n        \"/admin/pages/new\",\n        data={\"slug\": \"events\", \"title\": \"Events\", \"body_md\": \"Coming soon.\",\n {"parentUuid":"2b324cb7-ce47-4ba7-8156-3a8802d8fb74","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfX3wmGGKFJi3DeNZth49","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017UfckY5hPeRjwYjC7TaM9e","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh issue comment 3 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings (medium effort) and resolution — legacy-DB migration\n\nThe migration added to bring existing databases off the old fixed-slug `CHECK`\nconstraint (previous comment on this issue) had its own bugs:\n\n1. **Not atomic — confirmed data loss on a mid-migration crash.** The\n   RENAME -> recreate -> copy -> drop sequence relied on `executescript()`\n   (which implicitly commits pending work before it runs) and the default\n   isolation level's DDL-autocommit behavior. I reproduced this directly: a\n   simulated crash (close the connection with no `COMMIT`) between the\n   recreate and copy steps left the database with the renamed `pages_legacy`\n   table still holding the real content, and a fresh, empty `pages` table —\n   which the app reads from — with the original data silently gone and no\n   later `init_db()` call able to detect or recover it. **Fixed:** the\n   migration now runs under `isolation_level = None` with an explicit\n   `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` / `COMMIT` (rolling back on any exception), using only\n   `conn.execute()` for every step — never `executescript()` — so the whole\n   rebuild is one real SQLite transaction. Verified with a new crash-simulation\n   regression test (`test_legacy_migration_is_atomic_against_a_mid_migration_crash`):\n   killing the connection before commit now leaves the original schema and\n   row fully intact.\n2. **Duplicate `sqlite_master` query on every `init_db()` call.** `init_db`\n   queried `sqlite_master` once to check whether `pages` already existed, and\n   the migration helper queried it again for the same table's `CREATE TABLE`\n   SQL. **Fixed:** `init_db` now fetches the `sql` column once and passes it\n   into `_migrate_legacy_page_slug_check`, which also gives it the\n   \"does the table already exist\" signal for free.\n3. **Ad hoc migration logic embedded in the hot restart path, with no\n   schema-versioning mechanism for future changes.** Accepted as-is for this\n   project: this is a small SQLite-backed student CMS with one migration\n   ever needed so far (see ADR-002's rationale for no ORM/migration\n   framework), and a `schema_version` table plus a generic migration runner\n   would be infrastructure well beyond what one fixed-shape correction\n   requires. If a second migration is ever needed, that's the point to build\n   the generic mechanism, not before.\n\nFull suite: **44 passed** (16 in `tests/test_pages.py`, including the new\ncrash-atomicity test).\nEOF\n)\"\n","description":"Post the migration-atomicity review findings and resolution to issue #3"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":426,"cache_read_input_tokens":229765,"output_tokens":1046,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":426,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1046,"cache_read_input_tokens":229765,"cache_creation_input_tokens":426,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":426},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_017UfckY5hPeRjwYjC7TaM9e":{"command":"cd /Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && gh issue comment 3 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings (medium effort) and resolution — legacy-DB migration\n\nThe migration added to bring existing databases off the old fixed-slug `CHECK`\nconstraint (previous comment on this issue) had its own bugs:\n\n1. **Not atomic — confirmed data loss on a mid-migration crash.** The\n   RENAME -> recreate -> copy -> drop sequence relied on `executescript()`\n   (which implicitly commits pending work before it runs) and the default\n   isolation level's DDL-autocommit behavior. {"parentUuid":"b43687b5-9b4a-43a5-8200-fe8ad13087bd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfX3zZBZx953Ei6qfE8BH","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Pushed. Summary:\n\n**Docs updated for full Pages CRUD:**\n- Spec #1: replaced the \"fixed, not freely creatable\" decision and its Out-of-Scope line with the corrected CRUD decision (done in the previous turn).\n- `CONTEXT.md`: \"Permanent pages\" entry rewritten as \"Pages,\" describing full create/read/update/delete with Home/Menu/Our Story as seeded starting content.\n- `notes/client-brief.md`: corrected the editor-exclusion wording and the \"Page structure\" section's \"Permanent pages are Home, Menu, and Our Story\" claim.\n- Issue #3: two comments recording findings and resolutions.\n\n**Existing-database migration — this surfaced a real bug I verified directly, not just assumed:**\n- An old database's `pages` table has the `CHECK` constraint permanently baked in (`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` never touches it), so without a migration the earlier fix would be silently inert on any real database.\n- Added a migration in `init_db()` that detects the legacy `CHECK` and rebuilds the table, preserving all rows.\n- **Code review caught that my first version of this migration wasn't crash-safe** — I reproduced the data-loss scenario directly (killed a connection mid-migration, reopened, found the real content orphaned in a renamed table while the app read an empty one) and fixed it by making the whole rebuild one explicit SQLite transaction (`isolation_level=None`, `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`/`COMMIT`, `execute()` only — never `executescript()`, which commits pending work implicitly).\n- Also fixed a duplicated `sqlite_master` query the review flagged, and declined its third suggestion (a general schema-versioning framework) as over-engineering for a single fixed-shape migration in this project.\n\n**Restart safety:** confirmed via test that deleting all pages and calling `init_db()` again (simulating a `cms serve` restart) does not recreate them — it now keys off \"did the table already exist,\" not \"is it currently empty.\"\n\n**Tests:** 44/44 passing, including two new regression tests (legacy-DB migration correctness, and crash-atomicity)."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":199,"cache_read_input_tokens":232896,"output_tokens":738,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":199,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":738,"cache_read_input_tokens":232896,"cache_creation_input_tokens":199,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":199},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"a520bd3a-3885-48e9-9490-eac50402ff6f","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CfX3zYhHnzcFxW1pSbDSY","type":"assistant","uuid":"a76999c1-3472-43f7-90f3-8bb5b468e04f","timestamp":"2026-09-29T03:52:37.562Z","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"a2316d11-3941-4d87-98fe-7d21dea1d9fa","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"2fa5b7df-506f-4d8e-a53d-7174fd72d15b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"main"}
